subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan reasoning through bundled Qwen catalog entries, documented custom bailian provider configs, or both?
rationale: Source inspection shows a real capability gap, but the permanent support boundary depends on vendor proof and maintainer acceptance of model/region-specific provider behavior.

options.title: Land verified slices
options.body: Review and land the custom-provider and catalog PR slices that have adequate proof, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

options.title: Request one consolidated fix
options.body: Ask contributors to combine bundled catalog, custom-provider inference, docs, and tests into one Qwen-provider PR after model-by-model vendor verification.

options.title: Defer broad support
options.body: Keep current conservative behavior and require stronger Alibaba Coding Plan proof before changing built-in reasoning flags or inference defaults.

recommendation.title: Land verified slices
recommendation.body: Review and land the custom-provider and catalog PR slices that have adequate proof, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Qwen provider surface and already routed this issue's product-boundary discussion.
